Heading: Workshop registration

Retained elements: registration is open for staff; protected phrase “through 30 November 2026”; required qualifier “subject to 20 available seats.”

Allowable compression: shorten “for staff” only if the audience context already establishes staff eligibility; retain the date and seat limitation exactly.

Format cues: one short plain-text heading; intranet-card length; maximum 40 words; concise body; no rich formatting required.

Omissions: no source elements should be omitted unless the staff audience is already explicit in the card context. The availability qualifier must not be removed because it is required.

CTA status: “Register.” is permitted and may be included.

Feasibility: feasible within 40 words using the approved source message and CTA.

Unresolved gaps: no destination link, registration instructions, or confirmation of whether “staff” needs further eligibility detail is supplied.
